functions.delete_trigger():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$DECLARE   node RECORD;  sub RECORD;   payload TEXT;   change TEXT DEFAULT 'delete';  data TEXT; BEGIN  FOR node IN     SELECT DISTINCT nodeid FROM "$subscription"    WHERE (objectid = OLD.id OR objectid = TG_TABLE_NAME) LOOP       data := '"' || OLD.id || '"';     FOR sub IN      SELECT change AS change, eventkey, subscriptionid       FROM "$subscription"      WHERE nodeid = node.nodeid           AND (objectid = OLD.id OR objectid = TG_TABLE_NAME)    LOOP        payload := '{"subscription": ' ||         row_to_json(sub)::text || ',"data":' || data || '}';        PERFORM pg_notify(node.nodeid, payload);     END LOOP;  END LOOP; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
functions.insert_trigger():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.insert_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$DECLARE   node RECORD;  sub RECORD;   payload TEXT; BEGIN  FOR node IN     SELECT DISTINCT nodeid FROM "$subscription"    WHERE objectid = TG_TABLE_NAME LOOP     FOR sub IN      SELECT 'create' AS change,eventkey, subscriptionid       FROM "$subscription"      WHERE nodeid = node.nodeid AND objectid = TG_TABLE_NAME    LOOP        payload := '{"subscription": ' ||         row_to_json(sub)::text || ',"data": {"id":"' ||         NEW.id || '","table": "' || TG_TABLE_NAME || '"}}';        PERFORM pg_notify(node.nodeid, payload);     END LOOP;  END LOOP; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
functions.to_camel_case(str text):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.to_camel_case(str text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$SELECT replace(initcap($1), '_', '');$function$
functions.update_trigger():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$DECLARE   node RECORD;  sub RECORD;   payload TEXT;   change TEXT DEFAULT 'update';  data TEXT; BEGIN  FOR node IN     SELECT DISTINCT nodeid FROM "$subscription"    WHERE (objectid = NEW.id OR objectid = TG_TABLE_NAME) LOOP     IF NEW.is_deleted THEN       change := 'delete';       data := '"' || OLD.id || '"';     ELSEIF NEW.lock IS NOT NULL AND OLD.lock IS NULL THEN       change := 'lock';       data := '{"id":"' || NEW.id || '","lock": ' ||       row_to_json(NEW.lock)::text || '}';     ELSEIF OLD.lock IS NOT NULL AND NEW.lock IS NULL THEN       change := 'unlock';       data := '"' || OLD.id || '"';     ELSE      data := '{"id":"' || NEW.id || '","table": "' ||       TG_TABLE_NAME || '"}';     END IF;     FOR sub IN      SELECT change AS change, eventkey, subscriptionid       FROM "$subscription"      WHERE nodeid = node.nodeid AND       (objectid = NEW.id OR objectid = TG_TABLE_NAME)     LOOP        payload := '{"subscription": ' ||         row_to_json(sub)::text || ',"data":' || data || '}';        PERFORM pg_notify(node.nodeid, payload);     END LOOP;  END LOOP; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

types.lock: username text, created timestamp with time zone, _nodeid text, _eventkey text, process text
types.mono: amount numeric, currency text, effective timestamp with time zone, base_amount numeric
